fix_pr.title: Fix numeric_range equality and hashing above sys.maxsize

agent_review.authorization_note: Owner explicitly delegated routine case reviews and resulting actions to project agents on 2026-11-21; the orchestrator assigned this case review to the regression reviewer role.
agent_review.notes: Reviewed the complete original NumericRangeTests::test_eq_above_maxsize body, including all six input rows and both original assertEqual observations, with unchanged body AST. Verified exact merged PR 1216 introducing commit and its passing first parent, merged PR 1345 fix and ancestry. PR 1216 introduced equality calls to public len(), causing OverflowError for valid ranges longer than sys.maxsize. The native historical production patch replaces those calls with cached arbitrary-precision _len and applies byte-for-byte without retargeting; its related hashing hunk is retained honestly but this selected reference directly proves equality behavior. Fresh normal validation passed base 3 times, failed bad 3 times with eligible builtin OverflowError and own introducing call coverage at lines 2344/2347/2350, and passed repaired 3 times. All applicable probes passed; fix_only is not applicable because no public API symbols were added. Complete upstream unittest baselines passed 897/896/896, and an independent official supplement passed the same counts on identical trees/image with summary SHA256 559eb9856950bbecc8ca3061dc732e0da95f70d03d1cc331199ea7e071feb2be. Verified image, Python 3.12.16, frozen dependency lock, grader/policy fingerprints, official Python base layer prefix on amd64, and successful matching implementation CI at 4c3d1e4. Trusted suite PID 256 and transport 70 are recorded; scored reference/probe limits remain PID 64 and transport/wall 10. Fresh standalone TestCase subTest propagates the first failure rather than producing six graded nodes. Upstream PR bodies are omitted rather than edited; exact raw snapshots remain private. Three seeds demonstrate bounded stability. Accept this genuine distinct mainline regression under the supported policy. This is an owner-delegated agent decision, not human attestation.
